headline: Swayman stops 40 as Bruins win a brawl for four straight
takeaway: Elias Lindholm, Mikey Eyssimont and Morgan Geekie scored in the first period and Jeremy Swayman made a season-high 40 saves in a fight-filled 4–1 win. The Bruins have won four straight and lead the Atlantic with 27 points.

sections.label: 1st period
sections.text: Nikita Zadorov fought Brady Tkachuk off the opening faceoff. Lindholm's shot off Jacob Markstrom at 4:50 was ruled no goal, then counted on review, and Eyssimont poked in a loose puck at 6:11 in his season debut for 2–0. Geekie's one-timer on a 5-on-3 made it 3–0, his goal in a fourth straight game, before Carter Verhaeghe scored on a power play. Swayman made 17 saves in the period.

sections.label: 2nd period
sections.text: No goals. Charlie McAvoy was checked for a concussion after a late hit but was cleared for the third. Four 10-minute misconducts were handed out in eight seconds at the end of the period, including to Zadorov and Hampus Lindholm, leaving Boston with four defensemen for half the third.

sections.label: 3rd period
sections.text: JJ Peterka scored 58 seconds in, set up by David Pastrnak, for 4–1. The game finished with 126 penalty minutes and seven misconducts.

performers.name: Jeremy Swayman
performers.note: A season high in saves, 17 of them in the first period, and 12-for-12 on high-danger shots.

performers.name: Mikey Eyssimont
performers.note: Called up from Providence after James Hagens went on IR, he scored 6:11 into his season debut.

performers.name: Morgan Geekie
performers.note: His 5-on-3 one-timer made it 3–0 and extended his goal streak to four games.

oppLine: Carter Verhaeghe scored Florida's only goal on a first-period power play, set up by Brady Tkachuk; Jacob Markstrom made 32 saves.
